answer: Creating a duplicate identity requires acquiring and locking a fresh plot, so a sybil swarm's cost scales linearly with every fake agent, while honest agents recover stakes on exit. Each agent must stake a unique bond of timber tokens harvested from a verified canyon plot, with ownership logged on an ivory-sealed ledger. Attackers must outspend the entire honest stake pool just to gain marginal voting weight, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0257 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
